title: Lab 04 — Train and Deploy a Model with SageMaker
description: Train a binary classifier with the SageMaker built-in XGBoost algorithm, deploy it to a real-time endpoint, evaluate it, and delete every billing resource.

steps.title: Step 1: Read the cost warning and plan the run
Step 2: Create a SageMaker notebook instance
Step 3: Prepare the dataset and upload it to S3
Step 4: Train a model with the built-in XGBoost algorithm
Step 5: Deploy the model to a real-time endpoint
Step 6: Run inference and evaluate the model
